clinical_text: Concurrent use of NSAIDs such as ibuprofen with warfarin can increase the risk of gastrointestinal bleeding and potentiate the anticoagulant effect.
Amiodarone can inhibit metabolism of simvastatin, increasing its plasma concentration and the risk of muscle-related side effects.
NSAIDs like ibuprofen may reduce the blood-pressure-lowering effect of ACE inhibitors such as lisinopril and increase the risk of kidney impairment.
age_note: Older adults have a higher risk of kidney impairment with this combination and should be monitored closely.

clinical_text: Combined use of acetaminophen and aspirin may have additive effects on pain relief; clinically significant interactions are uncommon at standard doses.
